title: Unit Price Balance
summary: Increased prices on units to increase mass tax effect and reduce spam late game causing games to drag out.
items: Dragoon, Officer gold cost increased from 200 to 300.
Field Gun gold cost increased from 300 to 400.
Grenadier gold cost increased from 150 to 200.
Howitzer, Color Guard gold cost increased from 400 to 500.
Lancer gold cost increased from 250 to 300.
Troop gold cost increased from 100 to 150.

title: Terrain and Line of Sight
summary: Terrain features (hills, woods, rivers, peaks, bridges, forts) now block or reveal vision and line of sight (LOS) exactly as described in the Map rules. Enemy units in woods require you to also occupy that woods to see or shoot them. Forts and LOS-blocking terrain create fogged segments you can't see into unless a friendly unit has advanced past the terrain blocking that segment in any row. Units on fort, hill, peak, or bridge footprints are visible only if you have LOS to that feature; hills and peaks also boost range or restrict movement. The new LOS model means you will only see or target enemies your side can actually spot, and fog updates dynamically as units move. All terrain rules follow the complete descriptions in the in-game Map and the wiki. Tooltips and training mode improvements included.
items: Terrain features now fully implement LOS and vision/fog: hills, woods, peaks, forts block vision (except to units standing on them); woods hide units unless your side occupies the same feature.
Cresting a segment (moving a unit past the center of blocking terrain) reveals that segment on all rows for your side.
Units behind their own fort have cover against shots from enemies past the fort. Hills and peaks grant cover and range bonuses, and restrict some unit types.
Bridges and rivers affect movement speed as described: infantry, cavalry, and artillery interact differently.
You only see enemy units your side could logically spot under these rules; fog of war now matches the map documentation.

title: Training Mode and Tooltips
summary: New features have been added to help new players get oriented.
items: Can start a training mode game against a bot or other random player. Only the bottom lane is active, and the game is slowed down.
Tooltips now show you the anticipated action when clicking/touching an object in the game.

title: 3D Client and Speed Tweaks
items: Choose the 3D client when creating or joining a game.
Game speed is now 2/3 the original speed. This should allow players to spend more time arranging their units and managin their economy.

title: Unit, Unit Controls, and Unit Icons Rework
summary: Unit names and controls have been updated to reflect the new unit types.
items: Map physics have changed from a 2D spave to a 1D lane with rows.
Swipe a unit into a matching unit type to Reform the line. Swiping to change lanes moves a whole line, but you may now only move one lane at a time.
Unit names have been updated and icons have been added to buy buttons so you know what they are.
Fields Guns (formerly Cannons), now bounce through units they hit into units behind them in the same row
Color Guard now restores causalties instead of boosting speed and attack speed.
Keeps shoot less, but not greatly increase health and fatigue recovery, unless the enemy takes your fort!
All units now Charge and Fall Back through all friendly units. All units collide normally otherwise.

title: Grand Strategy
summary: Per-lane fire priorities: Bastion, Attrition, and Terror.
items: Two strategy buttons sit under the buy row, one for each lane. Click or swipe right to cycle Bastion → Attrition → Terror; swipe left to go back.
Bastion aims at the closest eligible target (the previous default).
Attrition aims at the healthiest eligible target (hp% − fatigue%).
Terror aims at the weakest eligible target.
Strategy only reorders targets inside the usual engagement and shoot ranges. Halt and lined volleys still use full range; advancing units still open at engage range.
Officer rules are unchanged: skirmishers may snipe officers; other units skip them while another target is in full shooting range.
Howitzers still fire closest per row and ignore lane strategy. Keep guns follow the top lane strategy.

title: Upkeep, Town Research & Grenadiers
summary: Living units cost gold over time, towns research upgrades with land, and grenadiers ignore bonus flanking damage.
items: Each living unit pays upkeep: 1% of its gold cost per second, multiplied by its remaining health. A unit at half health pays half.
Upkeep cannot drop gold below zero.
The gold per second beside your treasury is income after upkeep.
The line under that shows your top-lane bonus, bank income, and upkeep. It turns red when upkeep is higher than income.
Speed, damage, and armor readouts moved to the bottom corners of the screen.
Unit alternates start unlocked. Swipe sideways on a buy button to switch; buy buttons start on the standard unit.
Alternates cost gold plus land (default 20% of their gold cost). A +land chip under the buy button shows that price when the alternate is selected.
Click a town you own to invest 1 land per second toward its upgrade. Click again to stop. Production ends if you lose the town; a new owner does not inherit it.
When you cannot fund every producing town, land goes to the towns closest to your keep first. Research keeps going after each rank until you stop or hit the cap.
The scoreboard shows net land per second, and the economy row lists the research land drain.
Move-order flashes appear above the unit selection readout.
Grenadiers ignore bonus flanking damage. Charge and other bonuses still apply; they remain troops for everything else.

title: Charge Through & Stack Resolve
summary: Cavalry can charge through friendlies, and stacked units peel apart instead of fighting through each other.
items: Dragoons and Lancers no longer collide with friendly units while charging.
When units that were passing through each other start colliding again (for example after leaving fallback), they step forward or back — whichever is shorter — until they no longer overlap.
Units cannot fire or melee while overlapping a friendly they collide with.

title: Happy Birthday!
summary: Men of the Line is now a game!
items: Game is live and complete!
You can not play as a guest, or log into Formbar to play ranked or matched games.
